name: @offhash/openapi-core
description: OpenAPI contracts for Offhash (common + identity + product domains)

scripts.bundle:domains: mkdir -p src/.bundled && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.json && redocly bundle policies --output src/.bundled/policies.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle policies --output src/.bundled/policies.json && redocly bundle scans --output src/.bundled/scans.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle scans --output src/.bundled/scans.json && redocly bundle hashes --output src/.bundled/hashes.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle hashes --output src/.bundled/hashes.json && redocly bundle erasures --output src/.bundled/erasures.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle erasures --output src/.bundled/erasures.json && redocly bundle antipatterns --output src/.bundled/antipatterns.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle antipatterns --output src/.bundled/antipatterns.json && redocly bundle endorsement --output src/.bundled/endorsement.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle endorsement --output src/.bundled/endorsement.json && redocly bundle configcerts --output src/.bundled/configcerts.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle configcerts --output src/.bundled/configcerts.json && redocly bundle reporting --output src/.bundled/reporting.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle reporting --output src/.bundled/reporting.json
